subject: EdgeWave subprocessor change notice + Order Form addendum coordination
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@edgewave.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@edgewave.com>
Date: 2025-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Notice: adding BrightStream as subprocessor (analytics pipeline)

Diego —

Quick heads-up: EdgeWave is planning to onboard BrightStream (analytics.cloud) as a subprocessor to run our analytics pipeline for the order form related to your Acme POC. We attached the formal change notice and a proposed DPA annex that covers the new scope.

Key points:
- BrightStream will process pseudonymized telemetry and feature-usage events; no raw user prompts will be sent.
- They will deploy in us-west-2 and will use AES-256 at rest.
- We propose adding a short Order Form addendum to list BrightStream as an approved subprocessor and the DPA annex as Exhibit B.

We want to move quickly here; can you confirm whether Redwood needs a separate subprocessor approval flow (signed order addendum) or if our proposed annex + SOC2 snapshot will suffice? Appreciate a quick call if useful.

Thanks,
Jordan
Head of Partnerships, EdgeWave

Attachments: edgewave-subproc-notice-20250821.pdf, EdgeWave-DPA-annex-v1.2.pdf

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@edgewave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: adding BrightStream as subprocessor (analytics pipeline)

Jordan —

Thanks for the notice and the annex. High level: we can accept BrightStream as a downstream processor but need to align on three items before we sign an Order Form addendum:

1) Evidence: we need a current SOC 2 Type II report covering the BrightStream environment that will host telemetry. A pen-test report or equivalent is helpful if SOC2 isn't available yet.
2) Data scope: confirm the exact telemetry fields (example: session_id, event_type, hashed_user_id). We must ensure no prompt text or unredacted PII is included.
3) Redlines to the DPA annex: one clause we cannot accept as written is the data-subject incident notification window — we require 24 hours for confirmed incidents. Also need to add a non-derogation clause referencing Redwood's MSA (Section 7.4).

Marissa / Priya — tagging you for legal/ops review. Priya, can you pick this up as a procurement/redlines lead and coordinate the addendum & DocuSign path? Marissa, can you confirm operational constraints for telemetry retention and allowed fields?

Jordan — happy to do a short 30-minute call tomorrow to resolve blockers if that speeds things up.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

On attachments: I saved your annex to the shared drive (link below) — will add any redline PDF once Priya reviews.

Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EdgeWave-DPA

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@edgewave.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-22T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: adding BrightStream as subprocessor (analytics pipeline)

Jordan / Diego —

Quick procurement & legal take after an initial pass:
- We need the annex in mark-up (PDF with tracked redlines or a Word file). I attached a short checklist and the minimal redline we require for incident timing and MSA reference.
- For order form mechanics: Redwood prefers an Order Form addendum that names BrightStream and references Exhibit B (DPA annex). That gives our contracts team a clean trace in our system.
- Evidence: if BrightStream cannot provide SOC2 Type II, an ISO 27001 cert + penetration test report is an acceptable stopgap for onboarding, but we will require SOC2 within 120 days of production.

Action items for EdgeWave: please produce a commented version of the DPA annex and a description of the telemetry fields BrightStream will send. For any fields that could contain identifiers, add a mapping of how they are pseudonymized/hashes.

Proposed next steps:
- EdgeWave provides redlined DPA annex + telemetry mapping by 2025-08-25 EOD.
- Redwood legal will produce a one-page Order Form addendum template for signature by 2025-08-27.
- If schedule slips, we escalate to commercial ops for temporary gating.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Legal Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline-checklist-minimum.docx

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@edgewave.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Trent <alicia.trent@edgewave.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@edgewave.com>
Date: 2025-08-25T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: adding BrightStream as subprocessor (analytics pipeline)

Diego / Priya —

Appreciate the clear asks and timeline. We attached the redlined annex (track changes) and a telemetry mapping spreadsheet. Highlights:
- BrightStream provided a SOC2 Type II report dated 2025-06 and a network pen-test summary.
- We accepted the 24-hour confirmed-incident notification and added the MSA reference clause.
- Telemetry is limited to session_id (hashed), event_type, event_timestamp, feature_flag, and aggregate metrics. No prompt text or user-generated content is included.

I also attached a draft Order Form addendum with the BrightStream line-item and a placeholder for Exhibit B. We can push these into DocuSign once Redwood confirms the addendum template.

Next: Priya, once you sign off on the redline I can route the DocuSign to your contract inbox. We aim to have BrightStream live for limited telemetry in staging by 2025-09-08.

Thanks,
Jordan
EdgeWave Partnerships

Attachments: EdgeWave-DPA-annex-v1.2-redline.pdf, BrightStream-telemetry-mapping.xlsx, orderform-addendum-draft.docx
